title: Detective Doggy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ichiko Hanamori, a rookie detective nicknamed 'Doggy' who dresses in Lolita fashion, joins a rough-edged Tokyo police squad in its violent crime unit. Her dog-like sense of smell sometimes cracks hard cases even as her clumsiness gets in the way. The josei series by the creator of Gokusen runs as an episodic comedy-mystery with a romantic subplot.
life_message: Staying true to yourself while working hard and finding your place on a team can make a real difference.
